name: Cama king de plataforma con cajones
adaptations: Solid feet are arched cutouts of the side panels; Knotty builds a plain base
Headboard corners are rounded; built square
Oil-wax finish approximated by the closest finish id (danish-oil)
Headboard sits on three posts and is narrower than the bed; built as a plain headboard
notes: Cama king de triplay de pino con plataforma, cuatro cajones (dos de cada lado, hacia el pie) y cabecera lisa de esquinas redondeadas.
